title: Remove Nth Node From End of List
statement: Given the head of a linked list, remove the nth node from the end of the list and return the resulting node values.
hints: Advance lead pointer n steps ahead of trail pointer.
Move both pointers together until lead reaches the tail.

solutions.title: Two-Pass Length Calculation
Single-Pass Two Pointers

editorial.approach: Fast and slow pointers with gap n: prepend a dummy node before the head. Advance a fast pointer n + 1 steps ahead of slow. Then advance both pointers one step at a time until fast reaches null. At this point, slow points directly to the node preceding the target node; remove the target by updating slow.next = slow.next.next.
editorial.why_optimal: Removes the target node in a single O(L) pass with O(1) auxiliary space without calculating list length in advance.
editorial.pitfalls: Deleting the head node (e.g. n == length) without using a dummy node leading to null dereferences or lost references.
